profile.headline: Software Engineer  at Raley's
profile.summary:
In my first tenure as a computer programmer, I discovered that coding provided me with a way to express my creativity while at the same time create efficient and optimized processes that bring value to the organization. 

I encountered many challenges that helped forge what I consider my best strengths: resourcefulness and adaptability. My first computer-programming job I worked in human resources department. After one week in the job, the managers told me of an opening where they have lost the only programmer-analysts they had. It was a great opportunity with the caveat that the experts had left the company and the job will require long hours to keep the current level of service. I accepted it and it was one of the best experiences in my career. I learned the new system and with only the help of the department manager, I was able to meet the service levels and to add new procedures and documentation.

In order to keep current with technology I returned to school at Sierra College. I took courses to improve my oral and written communications skills, to obtain management expertise, and to upgrade my technical knowledge in the areas of computer networking, virtualization, and server management. I took classes to prepare me for CompTIA A+,  Network+, Network Security and Linux certifications. I achieved the President’s Honor Roll for spring, fall semesters 2014, and spring 2015 with a GPA of 3.8.

I strive for continually improving and learning. I love languages and culture. I am proficient in English, Spanish, and Portuguese. Communication is as important to me as it is to keep abreast of new technology.

I am seeking to be a part of a team where my skills can be of great value and I can continue to grow professionally. Creativity, productivity, and personal development continue to be of paramount importance to me.

For any inquires and job related opportunities, please contact me at omendoza_it@yahoo.com.

positions.title: Computer Lab Assistant
positions.description:
* Provide assistance and guidance to students with any of the Windows Office 2013 suite products.
* Professor's Assistant of Microsoft Office CIS classes.
* Provide support and help students with Windows 7 and Windows 8.1 problems.
* Provide assistance with different software applications that are utilized in the school CIS curriculum.
* Assist  CIS professors with preparing different materials used in class and in the lab.
* Troubleshoot different hardware issues and report or scalate as necessary.
* Oversee student activities and manage situations that can be disruptive while enforcing lab rules.
* Communicator and attending different inquiries from the students.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: 500 West Capitol Ave. West Sacramento, CA 95605
positions.description:
* Develop and support COBOL/CICS/DB2 applications for legacy Warehouse Management System. Including design and integration of interfaces to Manhattan Associates WMS platform. On-Call and troubleshooting.
* Support of Point-of-sale system Windows 2003 server environment. On-Call and troubleshooting.
* Design and support of EDI system utilizing Boomi message oriented middleware and legacy infrastructures.
* Support of financial applications running on People's Soft infrastructure. On-Call and troubleshooting.
* Develop Java applications in Eclipse IDE with Struts, HTML, XML, SOA, PL/SQL.
* Develop with relational databases DB2 and Oracle.
* Support and use of operating systems: IBM OS/390, Unix, Linux, Windows XP, Windows Server 2003.
* Writing and organizing documentation of all supported applications.
* Knowledge of SDLC methodologies.
